_doc: The ONE source of truth for the shape of every data file the plugin and its gates read.
Read by tools/validate_data_schemas.py (CI: stingtools-plugin.yml > Validate data files) and by the C# tests that hold a reader to its declared columns.
How to change a data file and its schema together: docs/DATA_SCHEMAS.md.

schemas    : full schema. csv-table = ordered columns (optional:true may be absent), type num|int|str, required, enum, min, pattern, unique. json = POCO-derived (poco) or hand-declared (keys) key sets.
structural : registered, format checks only (UTF-8, line endings, strict JSON / parseable CSV) — with the reason there is no deeper schema.
nonData    : glob -> reason, for binaries and documentation under a root.
schemaVersion is per file: bump it whenever a column or key is added, removed, renamed or reordered.

roots.uniqueBasenamesReason: StingToolsApp.FindDataFile resolves by bare file name and returns the first hit, so a second file with the same name anywhere under Data is never read.

nonData.StingTools/Data/**.rfa: Revit families (binary). Audited by FamilyConformanceCheck, not by this gate.
nonData.StingTools/Data/*.xlsx: Excel reference workbooks (binary); human-facing guides, read by no loader.
nonData.StingTools/Data/**.dyn: Dynamo graph (Generative Design); authored in Dynamo.
nonData.StingTools/Data/*.py: Python script shipped as data (template validation).

forbidden.*/_BIM_COORD/project_config.json: every project_config.json reader looks BESIDE THE .rvt (then the plugin data folder), never in _BIM_COORD/; a copy there is never applied. Ship it at the template's root (DSCH-19).
